description: A deploy 20 minutes before the alert introduced a slower Avro deserialization path with a 3s schema-registry timeout. Consumer lag climbs steadily; error rate and CPU stay normal. Correct root cause: the deploy.
correct_root_cause_summary: PR #482 (Avro deserialization + schema-registry client) merged 20 minutes before the alert; the added per-message schema-registry round trip is the direct cause of the consumer lag climb.

alert.message: Consumer lag for orders-consumer exceeded 50000 messages

logs.message: schema-registry request timed out after 3000ms, retrying (attempt 1)
schema-registry request timed out after 3000ms, retrying (attempt 1)
schema-registry request timed out after 3000ms, retrying (attempt 2)

deploys.title: Switch order-events deserialization to Avro schema v3
deploys.author: j.rivera
deploys.diff_summary: Replaces JSON deserializer with Avro deserializer for order-events topic; adds schema-registry client with a 3s request timeout per message.

files_changed.snippet:
-        self.deserializer = JSONDeserializer()
+        self.schema_client = SchemaRegistryClient(url=SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL, timeout_s=3.0)
+        self.deserializer = AvroDeserializer(self.schema_client, schema=ORDER_EVENT_SCHEMA_V3)

-        payload = self.deserializer.decode(msg.value())
+        # Avro path requires a schema-registry round trip per message; no local cache yet.
+        payload = self.deserializer.decode(msg.value(), ctx=self.serialization_context)
